title: Put sublist into check step
goal: Nests an unordered sublist within an associated ordered list item.
summary: handover equipment. The power cord and protective case are two things to check in the first step.
tasks: Let the direct children of the ordered list #checklist be only "inspection equipment" and "Submit record".
adds ul in the first li, which contains two li's "power cord" "protective case" in sequence.

example.note: Each sublist is placed in the corresponding li, and the sublist itself has its own list item.

hint: First find the end tag of the first item and write ul in front of it.
